input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusivity on us (the Company/Customer): we may not participate in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI holds the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer web site. This runs for "the term of this Agreement," which under Section 4.1 renews automatically each year, so it is effectively open-ended exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit — the walk-away scenario under the rule. HDI's own restriction in Section 6.3 and the closeout carve-out in Section 6.2 benefit us and are left untouched. Because HDI bears all Site costs and gives a reciprocal two-year covenant, we took the fallback rather than deleting Section 6.1: the restriction is already confined to a defined product category (Deerskin Products), and we added a twelve-month cap plus automatic termination if HDI misses its service level, availability or delivery date obligations (e.g., Sections 1.6 and 1.7).

proposal.summary: Cap Section 6.1 exclusivity at 12 months and add automatic termination on HDI performance failure
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.1 binds us to exclusivity for the entire (automatically renewing) term with no exit if HDI underperforms, so we have limited it to twelve months from the Effective Date and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses the service level, availability or delivery dates it has promised. Our preferred position is no exclusivity on the Company at all, but we can live with this narrowed, performance-conditioned version given HDI bears the Site costs; HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 is unchanged.

The Exclusivity Period and the Company's obligations under this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, without further action by either Party, upon any failure by HDI to meet the service level, availability or delivery date requirements of this Agreement, including without limitation Sections 1.6 and 1.7.
